title: federation: status for requests rejected by the replay restart rule
description:
draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 §Security (replay): 'A receiving server whose nonce cache is lost, for example on restart, SHOULD reject requests whose created precedes the restart'. §Request Signing says a request failing verification gets 403. The draft does not say which status the restart rule uses. Because created has one-second resolution, a request signed in the same second the receiver restarted is rejected by this rule; with 403 the sender treats it as permanent (is_transient retries only 5xx) and the message is lost. Found by chinwag's two-server test (chinwag bead chinwag-nuqe.7.23).

Decision taken in chinwag (Mark, 2026-10-30): answer 503 for this case, so the sender re-signs with a fresh created/nonce and retries; nothing unverified is accepted. Proposed draft text: a request rejected only because its created precedes the receiver's restart MUST be answered with 503 (Service Unavailable), and the sender retries it as a transient failure with a new signature; 403 stays for every other verification failure.
